name: POST /api/dialer/campaigns/:campaign_id/contacts/:contact_id/dial - Dial one contact now
description: Dials one campaign contact immediately. The call is placed through POST /api/voice-agent/calls' own placeCall, so it passes the SAME dialer gate chain as a single API call (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC3 — a single outbound AI call request is dispatched through the same gate chain as campaign contacts): campaign_active (contacts only; skip for API calls), number_in_flight (defer while the tenant is already on the phone with that number), dnc (refuse 'dnc' when the number is suppressed under voice, sms or all) consent (refuse 'consent_missing' without an active ai_voice_outbound receipt for the contact's person_id), calling_window (defer 'outside_calling_window' to when the campaign window next opens in the contact's timezone, else the campaign default) and recording (stored as the call's recording_consent), with concurrency gates joining the same chain. Every verdict is stored on the call's gate_verdicts; the call and the contact become queued, deferred (with next_attempt_at) or refused, and the call is put on dialer.dispatch_queue. 201 with the call; a retried dial of the same attempt replays it (200). The campaign must be running and the contact pending or deferred (409).

testCases.name: Refuse to dial a contact of a campaign that is not running
Dial a pending contact of a running campaign

errorCases.message: campaign is draft; start or resume it to dial contacts | contact is queued and cannot be dialled | agent has no published version
errorCases.when: campaign not running, contact already worked, or the agent cannot place calls
